metadata.title: Font embedding repro
metadata.description: Tangerine reached two ways: through the theme's heading font and through an explicit font.family on a paragraph. Export with fonts mode "embed" and open on a machine without Tangerine installed.

props.text: Body text stays in Calibri. The heading above takes Tangerine from theme.fonts.heading; the theme's fontRegistry points at the two TTF files next to this document.
Regular 400 set in the document, **and bold 700**.
